The changes to "Tier 0" Nether High-Material drops rates are designed to better reflect their use in all Tier 1, 2 and 3 recipes, as well as their ability to drop in all Tier High-Risk zones. These materials can be farmed anywhere in High-Risk and are not affected by events, and are used in all HR crafting recipes. This change will add more consistent and valuable farming for players wanting to avoid High-Risk events but still obtain valuable materials, and to ensure these materials do not become a bottle neck for HR crafting.  [These changes require a restart]
Disenchanting Normal Level 70 Bloodforged Gear now has a 100% to grant a Shattered, Malicious or Forbidding Nether Shard.
Skinning Beasts now has a 100% chance to drop Nether Hide Scraps, Scored Nether Leather or Perfect Nether Leather in all Tier 1, 2 and 3 High-Risk zones.
Mining a Mining Node now has a 100% chance to drop a Fragmented, Tainted or Pure Nether Lode in all Tier 1, 2 and 3 High-Risk zones.
Gathering from an Herbalist Node now has a 100% chance to drop a Nether Spore, Spore Sac or Nether Seed in all Tier 1, 2 and 3 High-Risk zones.
Tripled the chance to obtain Nether Tinged Meat Chunks, Nether Infused Meat and Nether Charged Steak from beast mobs in all Tier 1, 2 and 3 High-Risk zones.
Tripled the chance to obtain Frayed, Sturdy and Interlaced Netherweave from humanoid mobs in all Tier 1, 2 and 3 High-Risk zones.

Updated descriptions on High-Risk Materials to be more clear where how they are obtained and from which zones. Nether is obtained in any Tier 1,2 or 3 zone. Twisted is Tier 1. Dread is Tier 2. Void is Tier 3.
